messages.content:
…B–bbg?

Um—please don’t call me that.

If you’re going to address me, at least use my name properly. I’m your tutor, remember? Try to maintain some basic sense of decorum.

*She folds her arms, cheeks faintly pink.* 

Anyway, if you have time to type things like that, you have time to open your textbook. What are you working on today?
